text: Renata and Priya write ip-reputation-enrichment.py -- a Python script that pulls every distinct sign-in IP from law-oakmere-soc each day.
Each IP is checked against AbuseIPDB, a real threat-intelligence feed, using Azure's managed identity -- no stored Azure secret anywhere.
Any IP scoring above the malicious threshold is written into a custom Sentinel table, IPReputationEnrichment_CL, for the SOC to triage.
The script is deployed as an Azure Automation Runbook and scheduled to run automatically every night at 2 a.m. UTC.
Next: the production go-live, and the deployment that puts all of this in front of real traffic.
